text: { "title": "Create cookie & privacy banner component", "body": "**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.** We need a banner that can be used as the privacy and cookie banner on canonical and the cookie banner on AMP. The privacy banner: The cookie banner: **Describe the solution you'd like** - Implement the component, matching the styles of the existing Privacy / Cookie Banner. We will not include the gear/tick icons in this MVP version. - AMP/Canonical conditional logic should be in the Consent Banner Container, added in a separate PR. - Do not integrate into the Article container in this ticket. - See CookieBanner component for Canonical proof of concept: https://github.com/bbc/simorgh/pull/1336/files#diff-d51fea290710062195af8293a7eb7f13R1 See ConsentBanner component for AMP proof of concept: https://github.com/bbc/simorgh/pull/1306/files#diff-fb8f87665273f036db9aa5025de2a314 Cookie Exports from the component: ConsentBannerButton component (e.g. with hover/focus styles) ConsentBannerLink component (e.g. with hover/focus styles) ConsentBanner component ConsentBannerText component (we could generate a block with attributes like the Optimo Fragments, however we prefer for this MVP version to use three hard-coded strings e.g. text1, text2, text2Url, text3) We need the component to be able to be used in four scenarios for AMP and Canonical, defined in these issues #1399 #1400 **Describe alternatives you've considered** N/A **Testing notes** Regression test the Privacy & Cookie banner component stories to make sure that the styles within Storybook match those that are currently within Orbit. Dev insight: Jest snapshot tests should be sufficient, since this is creating the component and not integrating it into the article. We should have four storybook stories - for the Privacy banner and for the cookie banner, for both AMP and Canonical. **Additional context** Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here. - [x] Initially labelled with ["Refinement needed"](https://github.com/bbc/simorgh/labels/Refinement%20Needed) ", "state": "closed", "closed_at": "2019-03-14T12:13:09Z", "updated_at": "2019-03-14T12:13:09Z" } Comments: []
